name: scroll-away
title: Scroll away
description: The exit counterpart to Reveal: hero text and headers clear away line by line as they scroll off the top, in place, lifting or receding, every line still in view at full contrast. Pure CSS, no scroll handler.
docs: Pure CSS on a view timeline: nothing is hidden before hydration, and reduced motion or a browser without scroll timelines leaves the content fully visible. It ends invisible and, once it has, ignores the pointer, so a link you can still see always works and one that has gone cannot be pressed. Pair it with Reveal (Reveal outside, ScrollAway inside) for something that arrives and leaves with the scroll. It owns opacity, transform and filter while it runs; put your own on a child. Clip a parent with overflow: clip, never overflow: hidden: a hidden overflow makes that parent the scroll container the timeline follows, and the animation stands still.
